details:
There could be a function of the VRChat Camera to record a short video (up to 10 seconds, or more) and be able to post it:

- On their profile page (Maybe a specific amount and VRC+ could expand it)

- On the world's page (So people can see what the world looks like before entering it)

- Maybe a way to show them in world just like prints (a little phone/tablet, possibly a VRC+ function ?)

- A feed of recommended shorts according to an algorithm, in the menu

There should also be a function to follow people, so you can see their shorts on priority.

Friends should be prioritized automatically.

The short videos should have a possibility for an upvote and also report button for TOS-noncompliant shorts

There could be a limit of shorts that a person is able to post everyday and VRC+ could expand this number.

There is a lot of ways this could go, but I think in general this is a good idea if the amount of traffic is OK.

It would help discoverability of Worlds and maybe also Avatars.
title: "VRChat Shorts" a concept for short videos shot with the VRC Camera
